The venue does label per item and does tag many dishes GF, which on its own would read as "options"; but it also states 「当店は設備上、完全除去食でのご提供は難しい…場合によっては、お料理の提供をお断りさせて頂きます」 and its own flagship carries a GF tag on the web page and a 小麦 tag on the printed menu. why: UNDER-RATED, and the record already knows it: gf_proposed_tier reads to "dedicated", held at "ask" by gf_uncited_downgrade only because nothing cited a source. The sources exist. FindMeGlutenFree titles the listing 「Dedicated Gluten-Free Bakery in Shibuya City」 with 「Reported to be dedicated gluten-free」 over 122 recent ratings, and two independent celiac reviewers — one self-described Symptomatic Celiac — filed it Dedicated GF with 「No symptoms」 within the last month. The operator is a wholly rice-flour business (米粉使用グルテンフリー料理のカフェ、パン屋、料理教室) whose pizza it calls 完全グルテンフリー. Recommend only; a dedicated badge needs REVIEW_PROTOCOL.md pass 3 and human sign-off.

note: Accurate throughout and rated far below its evidence. Every claim is now citable to the venue site or FMGF; only two edits are needed — delete the unevidenced 'egg-containing breads', and add the summer stock restriction so nobody travels for a curry pan that is off sale.
